Nintendo's first special-edition Switch 2. Triforce dock, green and gold Joy-Con, $519.99. Under two weeks to go, and finding stock is still the real boss fight.
The N64 legend, rebuilt for Switch 2. Real jump button, free camera, and yes, you can hum into the mic.
Under five weeks out. Preload opens Nov 12. The internet is already counting the minutes.

t: Star Wars: Galactic Racer is a hit
d: Ten days after launch, reviewers are calling it one of the best racing games in years, and Steam players are still lining up for podracer and speeder chaos.

Valve's hero shooter and MOBA mashup is still invite-only, and it just hit about 303,000 players at once on Steam. That's past Team Fortress 2's all-time peak, which it first beat on Oct 9. A new hero vote keeps pulling people back.

Nov 6 is a huge day for collectors: the Delta Reign set (Elite Trainer Box $49.99) and the 30th Celebration Ultra-Premium Collections (Day with Espeon ex, Night with Umbreon ex, reported $179.99 each) both launch. Prerelease events start Oct 24 at local game stores, and Pokémon Center pre-orders sold out in about two hours.
Paul Bettany is back as Vision and James Spader's Ultron is in his head. Episodes 1 and 2 dropped Oct 13, with new ones on Tuesdays.

t: Crystal Lake is streaming on Peacock
d: The Friday the 13th prequel dropped all eight episodes at once, with Linda Cardellini as Pam Voorhees. Critics are split on the pace, fans are binging anyway: 75% with critics and 86% with audiences on Rotten Tomatoes.

t: Girls is coming back to HBO
d: Lena Dunham is reviving Girls for five episodes, and Allison Williams, Jemima Kirke, Zosia Mamet and Andrew Rannells are all back. Production starts in 2027, a decade after the finale.
Prime Video weekly drops; Stolas is trending hard on X. Part 1 finale lands Oct 28.

t: You Can See Everything is a box office story
d: Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim's Elizabeth Holmes documentary took an estimated $15M from just 855 theaters, about $17,500 a screen. Boxoffice Pro calls it the second-biggest non-concert documentary opening ever, behind Fahrenheit 9/11. Final numbers land Monday.
Paramount estimates $31M from 3,575 theaters, plus $20.1M overseas for a $51.1M worldwide start. That's No. 1, and a solid start rather than a breakout. Audiences gave it a B- CinemaScore.
Greta Gerwig's Narnia, scored to Stairway to Heaven, with Meryl Streep voicing Aslan. Big swing. Our take: it works.
Last weekend's winner made an estimated $8.35M in weekend two, down 70%, for $44.85M total. New openers Whalefall ($8M against $10M to $12M tracking) and Sense and Sensibility ($7.25M) came in soft.
Search singer, vinyl, season and character on Pinterest, screenshot the first image for each, and post the grid. It's your algorithm's read on you, in four squares, and it's weirdly accurate.
Witches and vampires top NRF's survey of what adults will wear, Spider-Man rules for kids, and Google's trending list is led by Buddy the Unicorn and NeeDoh. Halloween is Saturday, Oct 31.
Olivia's first-ever remix and Chappell's first-ever feature, out now. The video is a retro game show hosted by David Byrne. Yes, really.

Her first new music since So Close To What: a synth-pop independence anthem with a video shot in the South of France. Fans are chanting the money line everywhere, and she was on the Victoria's Secret Fashion Show lineup Sunday.

t: Harry Styles sings for Liam Payne
d: On the second anniversary of Liam Payne's death, Harry debuted an unreleased song he wrote for his friend, "What Is Enough," at Madison Square Garden. "It's just about looking after each other," he told the crowd.
At her Hollywood Bowl show for the new album Bass Persuades on Oct 16, Miley Cyrus honored her late godmother Dolly Parton before singing "Jolene": "Me and Dolly, we are eternal."
Second straight week at No. 1 on the Hot 100. Her 16th chart-topper. TikTok is using it for wedding edits.

t: Drake & Don Toliver debut at No. 5
d: New collab, straight into the Hot 100 top 5. Also on that chart: ADÉLA's first top 10.
girl in red's song is still one of the fastest-climbing TikTok sounds, with 2M+ videos. Peak fall.
The 2027 nominees drop Monday, Nov 16. The ceremony is Feb 7 on ABC, Disney+ and Hulu.

Milwaukee is going to the World Series for the first time since 1982. They swept the two-time champs, capped by a 6-4 comeback in Game 4 on Garrett Mitchell's go-ahead homer. Jake Bauers was NLCS MVP.

t: Rays one win from the World Series
d: Drew Rasmussen threw seven strong innings and Tampa Bay beat Cleveland 3-1 in Game 5 for a 3-2 ALCS lead. Game 6 is tonight at 8 p.m. ET at Tropicana Field on TBS, truTV and HBO Max, with Freddy Peralta set to start for the Rays. A Guardians win forces Game 7 on Tuesday.

Golden State leads 1-0 after a 68-64 Game 1 win behind 26 points from Gabby Williams. Game 2 is tonight at 8 p.m. ET at Chase Center on USA, Peacock and CNBC. Atlanta's big fix: it shot 2-for-19 in the fourth quarter of Game 1.
Tuesday! Knicks raise the banner, LeBron debuts for Philly, and NBC has the first-ever opening tripleheader.
84-game season, split between ESPN and TNT. Heritage Classic Oct 25.

t: Packers top Cowboys on Sunday night
d: Green Bay beat Dallas 23-13 on Sunday Night Football, and Cowboys names filled X's US trends overnight. For full NFL coverage, follow the official recaps.
Will Ospreay kept the AEW World title in the first-ever Clockwork Carnage match in Orlando, finishing with 3 points to 2 each for Adam Copeland, Samoa Joe and Darby Allin.
Google's new frontier model, out Oct 13 with a 1M-token window. It's pitched as less hedgy and less cliché.
Frontier labs went closed this week (hello, Muse Wonder). Open-weight models and small labs are still the other half of the story.
Meta's first frontier model. Not open-weight this time, which is a big shift from Llama.
Microsoft's third in-house AI chip. The pitch: 40% better performance per megawatt. Deployment is planned for 2027.

OpenAI is rolling out GPT-Live-1.1 in ChatGPT Voice with more natural accents and new voices for French, German, Hindi, Japanese, Korean and Mexican Spanish. Developers can now design a custom voice from a text prompt.

Apple's first foldable ($1,999 for 256GB) opened for pre-order on Oct 16 and lands Friday, Oct 23, with a 7.6-inch inner screen and a 5.4-inch outer one. MacRumors says pre-order wait times are already significant.
Pinterest's first Beauty Trend Report says hair is going warm and moody: mocha, copper, cherry cola.
Milky, blush-nude nails beating burgundy this fall. Quiet but very chic.
Clean girl is taking a night off. Runways from Saint Laurent to Gucci brought the smoke back.

t: Victoria's Secret names a new Angel
d: Solange Omon, 21, won the Angels Among Us search and made her runway debut at Sunday's show in Los Angeles, with an IMG Models contract. The other headline: Kylie Jenner walked in the $50 million Fantasy Bra, the first Fantasy Bra on the runway since 2018.

Jacob & Co. built it with 4,410 diamonds around a 75.54-carat Fancy Vivid yellow diamond. It took 15 craftspeople more than 1,000 hours, weighs just under four pounds, and at $50 million it's the priciest Fantasy Bra ever, per Vogue.

t: Taco Bell x Milk Bar Birthday Cake Empanada
d: Out now nationwide. Cake-flavored empanada with pink frosting and sprinkles. $3.49. Chaotic in the best way.

t: Wingstop x Sour Patch Kids wings
d: Wings in a sour-then-sweet glaze. We're scared. We're also going.
The Halloween Spider Donut returns, plus a purple Berry Battie drink.
A new Honey Chicken Biscuit with a Megan Thee Stallion merch tie-in.
A Brazilian funk track: count on your fingers, shrug on the drop. J-Hope did it and the top video hit 75M+ views.
A creepy low-angle shot zooms out to reveal the Halloween fit, set to Róisín Murphy. Easy to copy, hard to stop watching.
Hold a pumpkin up to the lens and congratulations, you're a pumpkin. Spooky-season gold.
Open your camera roll, find the sixth picture, and post it as your mock "cause of death." Geckos, toilet-paper dogs and crash-test cars so far. Started Oct 16 and spread fast.
Side-by-side photos from lockdown days next to 2026 mirror selfies: gym glow-ups, beards, brand-new hair. Some proud, some hilarious, all very this weekend.
Synthetic cats acting out family dramas and tiny tragedies. Weirdly emotional, and a fast-breaking format.

Every House seat, 35 Senate races and 36 governor races are on the ballot Nov 3. Last week's polls cut both ways: Bowling Green/YouGov has Brown (D) up 48-42 in Ohio, InsiderAdvantage has Collins (R) trailing Jackson (D) 49-47 in Maine, and the same pollster has Paxton (R) up 49-48 in Texas. Most margins are inside the error.

t: Shutdown watch: the real deadline is Dec 11
d: Correction: there is no Oct 31 funding cliff. The stopgap law signed Sept 2 (H.R. 6500) funds the government through Dec 11, 2026. Congress is out until after the election, and leaders in both parties will face that deadline in the lame-duck session.

t: White House press secretary out after 5 days
d: Katie Zacharia is leaving the press secretary job after five days, NBC News reports. A senior official says she's moving to a new role. It followed criticism of her first briefing and her acknowledgment that she did not pass the bar exam. She thanked the president in a statement.

t: 60 Minutes on the people who count the votes
d: Lesley Stahl's Sunday report, "The Vote," looked at federal actions affecting state and local election officials ahead of Nov 3, including an FBI search of a Fulton County, Georgia election warehouse and Justice Department requests for voter rolls. It featured Utah Lt. Gov. Deidre Henderson and Justice Department official Harmeet Dhillon, so both state officials and DOJ gave their side.
After the election, Congress gets about 24 legislative days. On the list: funding past Dec 11, the defense policy bill, and farm and surveillance reauthorizations.
Can courts still defer to Sentencing Commission commentary after Loper Bright? Justices from both wings sounded skeptical of changing the rule. A decision is due by July.
This week's argument asked how far the Video Privacy Protection Act reaches. It matters for every site that embeds video.

After the U.S.-brokered energy truce fell apart, Ukraine launched more than 1,000 drones at Russia on Oct 18, AP reports. In St. Petersburg, fires broke out at the St. Petersburg Oil Terminal and the Ruchi oil depot, at least one person was killed, and Pulkovo Airport briefly restricted flights.

t: France: 2,400 arrests after a weekend of riots
d: Saturday's cost-of-living marches drew about 550,000 people, and arrests from the weekend's violence and looting have climbed to about 2,400, including 351 in Paris. Macron called for calm and refused Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez's resignation, and the prime minister is holding a crisis meeting.

Houthi strikes hit Riyadh's airport and an Aramco building this week. On Friday Saudi Arabia said it intercepted several missiles over the Red Sea, including one headed for the Yanbu oil terminal. Several airlines have suspended flights to the region.

t: Hormuz: Iran floats a reopening plan
d: Iran says it would reopen the Strait of Hormuz under a seven-day plan if the U.S. meets its conditions, including ending hostilities and lifting the naval blockade. Washington hasn't accepted, and Qatar is mediating. Last week at least nine ships were attacked near the strait. Brent eased to about $107 on Monday morning after touching $110.

Kenya now has seven confirmed cases of Bundibugyo virus disease, a type of Ebola, including one death, all linked to a traveler from DR Congo. Every new case was found among people already in quarantine. DR Congo has reported 9,277 confirmed cases and 4,478 deaths since May, per ECDC. The CDC has entry rules for U.S.-bound travelers from affected countries.

Japan's weather agency sent an emergency alert for a magnitude 9.9 quake on Oct 16, then withdrew it about eight minutes later. The real quake was a 6.9 near Kamchatka. JMA apologized, explained the error and denied any cyberattack.
A Barclays note says a Tesla-SpaceX merger could be announced before Tesla's December annual meeting, and Musk's "Tesla x SpaceX" post poured fuel on it. Nothing has been announced.
The crop-chemicals maker slashed its Q3 outlook, blaming weak demand, pricey inventory sitting with distributors and cheaper generics. Shares hit a multi-decade low.

t: Barclays cools on Dell and HPE
d: Barclays cut both to hold, questioning when enterprise AI spending really shows up. Dell fell 6.8% and HPE 7.1% on Oct 15.
The dating-app company agreed to an all-cash deal with Ithaca Holdings, according to its SEC filing.
It's official: Social Security and SSI rise 3.6% in 2027. About 76 million Americans. SS payable January 2027; SSI from Dec 31, 2026. Taxable max $192,300. Biggest bump in three years.
Oct 15 through Dec 7: compare 2027 Medicare Advantage and Part D plans. Changes take effect Jan 1. Different from HealthCare.gov open enrollment (that opens Nov 1).

AAA's national average for regular was about $4.33 on Oct 16, and diesel is $6.33, more than 70% above a year ago. U.S. crude closed above $100 Friday for the first time since September as Hormuz attacks and refinery strikes hit supply.
Freddie Mac's 30-year average didn't budge this week and is still at a three-year high. The next reading is Thursday, Oct 22.

t: Flu shot: aim for end of October
d: CDC says everyone 6 months and older should get a flu shot, ideally by the end of October. People 65+ should get the high-dose types.
CDC's current COVID shot guidance is a shared decision with your provider. It's especially important for 65+ and high-risk people.
Porsche revealed a mid-engined super sports car concept on the same Queens pier where the 550 Spyder debuted in 1953. A production version will sit above the 911. Engine and price: not announced.
A trailer-brake-control recall covering F-Series, Ranger, Maverick and Lincoln models. Check your VIN.
About 202,000 SUVs whose tire-pressure monitors may not warn you.
Home Depot's giant skeleton is back, now with app-controlled moves and LCD eyes. $299 original, $379 upgraded.
Dogs still lead at 88.9M to 77M cats, but more US households now own kittens than puppies.

t: Cat vet visits up, dog visits down
d: Feline clinic visits rose 2.7% in Q3 while dog visits fell.
It went live Sept 23, the earliest launch ever. Some aid is first-come, first-served, so file early.
New England is peaking now. The Midwest and Mid-Atlantic follow mid-to-late October, and the Southeast peaks into early November.

t: Santa Ana winds fade, rain on the way
d: NWS Los Angeles says all red flag warnings and heat advisories have expired. A big cool-down starts today, and 0.25 to 1 inch of rain is very likely Wednesday and Thursday, so watch for mud and debris flows near burn scars.

A storm-force low is sitting a few hundred miles off the Southeast coast, and the National Hurricane Center says high winds, coastal flooding and dangerous surf are expected along parts of the East Coast over the next few days. It has a 40% chance of turning subtropical this week as it pulls away.
A nightclub proposal in Scottsdale, complete with a bottle-girl sign. She said yes.

t: Academy Museum Gala: Taylor Swift closes the night
d: Taylor Swift performed at the sixth Academy Museum Gala in LA on Oct 17, in a pale-blue Dior gown. Rosé went sheer Saint Laurent with a giant bow. The honorees were Charlize Theron, Colman Domingo and John Carpenter.
The Jersey Shore star and Nikki Hall got engaged in Vegas after six years together.
Jennifer Meyer married Geoffrey Ogunlesi in Hawaii, and her ex Tobey Maguire officiated. Peak co-parenting energy.
Hinge's payers grew 17% while Tinder's fell 5%. Dating is shifting from swipes to intentional.
Reviewers say singles want fewer swipes and more verified, IRL-first apps.
Honest local food reviews, city by city. TikTok's favorite format this month for small spots.
No single mega-challenge this month. Instead, lots of micro-trends: costume transitions, K-pop revivals, cat edits.

Tesla reports Q3 results after the close Wednesday, Oct 21, with a webcast at 5:30 p.m. ET. It already said it delivered 486,532 vehicles last quarter. The SpaceX merger talk is still just a Barclays note. Not advice.

The big reports land this week: GM and Netflix on Tuesday, Tesla and Meta after the close Wednesday, Procter & Gamble on Thursday. Earnings season is when stocks move most on company news. Not advice.
After a big run, Moderna fell 7.82% to $218.01 on Oct 16 as traders took profits ahead of full Phase 3 melanoma vaccine data due Oct 24. Not advice.

t: Futures bounce after the chip rout
d: After a week in which the Nasdaq 100 fell 5.5%, Nasdaq 100 futures were up 1.3% and S&P 500 futures 0.7% early Monday, with Brent down about 2.4% near $107, per Bloomberg. Meta, Tesla and chipmakers report this week. Futures can reverse by the open. Not advice.
All evacuation orders for the Norte Fire in south Orange County were lifted by Saturday evening, with the fire at 570 acres and 25% contained. Some roads and the burn area stay closed.

Police say a 16-year-old forced his way into Silver Rail Elementary on Thursday and killed three children and a teacher. A teacher fought him and a parent shot him, AP reports. The school district has a community hub with support resources.
HealthCare.gov opens Nov 1. Enroll by Dec 15 for Jan 1 coverage. It closes Jan 15.

t: SpaceX CRS-35 docked at the ISS
d: Dragon arrived Oct 15 with 6,300+ lbs of cargo, including the station's final roll-out solar arrays.
NASA finished stacking the boosters for the Moon-landing mission, with all four RS-25 engines installed.

Delta, Lufthansa, Air France-KLM and Qatar Airways were among the airlines that suspended flights to Saudi Arabia and nearby countries after strikes on Riyadh's airport. Check your airline before you go.
